In CNIL’s practical AI guidance sheets, age information should be handled by prioritizing the least intrusive format without losing relevant information. For example, it is recommended to use age or age ranges instead of complete birth dates. 

In the context of a diagnosis-aid system, an example provided suggests generalizing age information by using broader categories such as [month-year] or [year] instead of [day-month-year]. This approach significantly reduces the risk of loss of confidentiality while still allowing the system to function effectively.
